Replace sell limit at updated round level
Five-minute candles, adaptive average, round levels and order life cycle

Scheme.Description: Uses finished five-minute candles and a Kaufman adaptive average to place one passive round-level limit in the crossing direction, replace an active limit when its calculated level changes, cancel it on the opposite crossing or after twelve candles, and protect each fill with a trailing stop.
